title: The Cosmos Fashioned as the Body, the Body as Field of Regeneration
description: An extended cosmic-man / body correspondence: head as firstfruit of garments, ten firmaments to heart, sphere-wheel as heart, living air to thighs, body as earth, with strongholds in liver/flesh/sinew. The five watches of governance through which the cosmic drama unfolded, and the same body now holding the Mind of Light and the New Man as the field of regeneration. 840-myriad inner archons, 12 zodiacal members on right and left, the body's wounds discharging defilement and water alike.
